findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_docs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the current documentation of react-three-fiber, drei, zustand, a11y, react-postprocessing, docs, react-three-jolt, sky, denoiser. Call this FIRST, before…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
